records.name: Aptech Aviation Academy
records.description: Aptech Aviation Academy is part of the Aptech Limited group and one of India's largest aviation training networks, offering programs in cabin crew training, airport management, pilot ground training, and aviation hospitality. With multiple centers across major Indian cities, Aptech Aviation prepares students for careers with airlines, ground handling companies, and airport operators. The academy is affiliated with the Aptech group's global network and provides internationally aligned aviation training.

records.name: School of Aeronautics
records.description: School of Aeronautics in New Delhi is a DGCA-approved aviation training institution offering programs in aircraft maintenance engineering (AME), aeronautical engineering, and aviation management. It is one of the established AME training institutes in northern India, providing hands-on training on actual aircraft and simulators. School of Aeronautics graduates are employed by airlines, MRO companies, and aviation regulatory bodies across India.

records.name: Rajiv Gandhi School of Intellectual Property Law, IIT Kharagpur
records.description: Rajiv Gandhi School of Intellectual Property Law (RGSOIPL) at IIT Kharagpur is India's premier institution for intellectual property law education, uniquely positioned within a leading technical university. It offers a five-year B.A. LL.B. (IP) integrated program, LL.M., and Ph.D. degrees that combine deep technical knowledge with legal expertise in patents, trademarks, copyright, and technology transfer. RGSOIPL graduates are highly sought after by IP law firms, corporate IP departments, patent offices, and technology companies both in India and globally.

records.name: National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities (NIEPMD)
records.description: National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities (NIEPMD) in Chennai is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, offering postgraduate and diploma programs in special education, disability rehabilitation, and occupational therapy. It provides rehabilitation services, inclusive education training, and research in multiple disability conditions. NIEPMD trains special educators, rehabilitation counselors, and disability management professionals across India and neighboring countries.

records.name: Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities
records.description: Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities (AYJNISHD) in Mumbai is a premier national institution under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for education, research, and rehabilitation related to speech, language, and hearing disorders. It offers B.Sc. and M.Sc. programs in audiology and speech-language pathology and provides clinical services to thousands of patients with communication disabilities annually. AYJNISHD is a WHO collaborating center and plays a key role in defining standards for audiological services in India.

records.name: Jamia Millia Islamia - Department of Educational Studies
records.description: Jamia Millia Islamia's Department of Educational Studies in New Delhi is a prominent teacher education and educational research department within one of India's leading central universities. It offers M.A. in Education, M.Ed., and Ph.D. programs with emphasis on curriculum studies, educational technology, and equity in education. The department is known for its critical pedagogy approach and has produced prominent educators and education policy researchers.

records.name: SNDT Women's University
records.description: SNDT Women's University in Mumbai is India's first university for women, established in 1916 by Dhondo Keshav Karve, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across arts, science, commerce, and education. It is a key institution for women's empowerment through education and has a strong tradition in home science, education, and library science. SNDT Women's University has campuses in Mumbai and Pune and serves thousands of women students from Maharashtra and neighboring states.

records.name: Banaras Hindu University - Faculty of Education
records.description: Banaras Hindu University's Faculty of Education in Varanasi is one of the oldest and most reputed faculties for teacher education in India, offering B.Ed., M.Ed., and Ph.D. programs with specializations in educational psychology, curriculum development, and inclusive education. The faculty is known for its emphasis on value-based education rooted in Indian philosophical traditions. BHU Education faculty alumni serve as teachers, school principals, education researchers, and policy advisors across India.

records.name: National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro-Sciences (NIMHANS)
records.description: National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro-Sciences (NIMHANS) in Bengaluru is India's apex institution for mental health and neurosciences, with the status of an Institution of National Importance, offering programs in psychiatry, clinical psychology, psychiatric nursing, psychiatric social work, and neurosciences. It is India's largest mental health referral center, attending to over a million patient contacts annually and providing unique training in complex neurological and psychiatric conditions. NIMHANS graduates are national leaders in mental health advocacy, clinical practice, and neuroscience research.

records.name: Amity Institute of Psychology and Allied Sciences
records.description: Amity Institute of Psychology and Allied Sciences in Noida is a leading private psychology institution under Amity University, offering B.Sc. Psychology, M.Sc. Clinical Psychology, M.Phil. (Clinical Psychology), and Ph.D. programs. The institute has modern psychology labs including EEG, biofeedback, and counseling simulation rooms, and a clinical training wing. Amity's large campus network and industry connections provide students diverse internship opportunities in corporate HR, hospital psychology, and NGO mental health roles.
